answer: To enter the haven, newcomers must stake 200 sables for entry, compute a jetty's capacity upon submission. Verifiers check this at epoch close, penalizing any mismatches with a 25% fee. Mass cloning loses money because a single sable costs 5 sables on a cloned submission, and if 50 sables are cloned, the cost becomes 250 sables, resulting in a 150 sable loss.
